approval_3.summary: v3 with grade v3b may go to the owner after one 0-token fix to the bench's front edge (the b*-only cap turned it mauve). The one-grade fix (the toe computed per file) is required before anything goes to the site; it does not change what the owner sees. The darker v3b (corner 82.6 against the ~86 the designer expected) goes to the designer's eye.

grading_points_qa_projection.verdict: v3b: the back-wall display targets met (centre 89.8, right 85.1); the corner 82.6 against the designer's expected ~86 (D1); the window wall Y 0.30 accepted by the designer (§13.1 (5), §13.3); the whole flat Y 0.30-0.65 now 72-76 (G1.8's 80-88 is a proposal): D1

bench_slab.finding: the lit top is no longer yellow (b* ~8); the cap clamps b* only and keeps a*, so the 8 cm front face went from ochre (h_ab 75) to mauve-taupe (Lab ~62.8/5.7/12.1, h_ab 65, HSV H 23.4 on the shell and 27.0 in the composites against G1.9's 'never H < 25 in white or beige'); at 100 % it reads lilac-grey next to the cream top. The mask also misses the front face's last ~40 px at the left end (303 px with b* > 20 in the 4 px ring)
bench_slab.fix: 0 tokens: cap the chroma along the slab's own hue (scale a* with b*, the face's a*:b* to the top's), and grow the mask to the left end; QA re-measures (no H < 25, b* <= 12, no yellow sliver)

swap_diff_display_graded.finding: outside the products and shadows the display files differ per set: up to 14,726 px over 2 levels (base->C, v3b), dE76 up to 2.7, all in the deep darks (L* 7-14). Cause: the black-point toe is computed per file (p0.5 after exposure: base 6.14, A 5.77, B 5.02, C 3.69 in v3b)
swap_diff_display_graded.fix: 0 tokens: one grade, its toe computed once (on the base) and applied unchanged to every file

halo_G2.3.finding: the ring statistic flags lit fabric ribs, fringes and cushion edges; each hotspot at x4 (and x8 on B) is the product's own texture, no light or dark band

cushions_G1.1.finding: all 12 items: the right silhouette, count, pattern and material against their SKU photos (overlays/cushions-set-*.jpg)

cushions_colour_G1.2.set_C_rule: designer §13.1 (4): rotate only if dE > 5 or > 8 deg off the SKU photo; inside both, and yellower (+2.8 deg), not redder: left as it is (#603326 on the card is a label hex)
cushions_colour_G1.2.light_items_note: white-normalised medians run warmer than the SKU photos (b* +7 to +15 on White, Milk Tea, Oatmeal, the linen lumbars, Light Brown); on the lit faces the gap is b* +2 to +4: the shaded half carries the room's warm bounce (bone sofa, oak, walnut). Not a failure; the Milk Tea lumbar is the closest to the line (lit face 5 L* darker and +3.9 b*)
